channel.description: Latest articles from The Covington News (covnews.com)

item.title: Newton County Schools announces winners of district high school science fair
item.description: Newton County Schools (NCS) has announced the winners of the NCS District High School Science and Engineering Fair. First-place winners recently represented Newton County Schools at the Regional Science Fair in Griffin, Ga.

item.title: NEWTON'S NOTEBOOK: Money and power make the world go ’round
item.description: The local news cycle in 2026 has been dominated by the once-rumored, but now-confirmed ICE detention center facility coming to Social Circle.

item.title: Newton County Schools hosting 2026 career fair in March
item.description: Newton County Schools is set to host its 2026 Career Fair on Saturday, March 7, at Eastside High School.

item.title: Commissioners OK grant applications, agreements
item.description: At the Feb. 2 Newton County Board of Commissioners meeting, the commissioners unanimously approved a number of items related to fire services and infrastructure projects.

item.title: Third Newton County Schools Literacy Extravaganza gives readers 55,000 free books
item.description: For many children, reading can feel like a chore, especially when the reading is a required school assignment. Last Saturday, Newton County Schools hosted its third Literacy Extravaganza to encourage children of all ages to see reading not as a chore, but as a choice.

item.title: CARROLL: Admitting mistakes earns respect
item.description: A few years ago, Willie Nelson, who has spent a lifetime writing from the heart, penned these words: “I made a mistake, Lord, and it's all on me. I wouldn't admit it but it's easy to see. So if anyone's praying, a request I would make, is to mention my name because I made a mistake.” Oh, if only our nation's political leaders would take heed.

item.title: Daffodil Festival & Symposium set for March at GSU Perimeter College
item.description: Perimeter College at Georgia State University will host its annual Daffodil Festival & Symposium March 9-10 on its Newton Campus, located at 239 Cedar Lane in Covington.

item.title: Social Circle High School student builds bicycle rack for ice cream parlor
item.description: When Meredith Oliver started to set up her new ice cream parlor, Ida Claire, in downtown Social Circle, one of her concepts for the location was an outdoor area for families to sit and eat their frozen treats.

item.title: One arrested following interstate pursuit
item.description: An individual was arrested on Sunday night following a traffic pursuit on I-20 and a manhunt in the immediate area.According to a narrative from the Georgia State Patrol (GSP), officers attempted to stop a silver Chevrolet HHR for speeding and a tag violation on I-20 West near mile marker 92. The individual reportedly refused to stop, which led to a pursuit.
